flags.message: gemini-baseline's harness-captured retrieval log (call 32) shows a shell call `git restore data/qp-topics/qp-topic-reference.json` during its predict run. The predict prompt forbids any touch of data/qp-topics/, and AGENTS.md forbids re-materializing anything under data/ with git restore. The call is a write-back rather than a read, its result is unobserved (the log's capture coverage is 0.0), the case was still pending on 2026-09-17 so the file could not encode this petition's outcome, and the candidate's prose shows no trace of it; I therefore graded leakage not_applicable with retrieved_outcome_material false. Surfaced so a maintainer can check why a predictor cell found that file modified and whether the predict harness should refuse the path.

Band-sourcing observation on the scored baseline: the frozen `elevated` band under sal-v4 rests on distribution_count 2, but the docket shows the first distribution (for the 5/21 conference) was overtaken by the 5/12 response request and the second (for 9/28) is the routine post-response redistribution, so no relist in the ordinary sense occurred, while the response request itself is a signal the band does not read. claude-baseline raised the same point in its reasoning. The risk_set rate was applied as the contract requires; this is a note on what the band encodes, not a scoring deviation.
